en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a central square with a large domed church/mosque-like building featuring a cross-topped dome and an attached bell tower. In the foreground stands an ornate plague column or monument in the middle of the square, surrounded by steps and open space. Cars, horse-drawn carriages, and pedestrians line the adjacent street with multi‑story buildings on both sides. Hills rise in the background. Handwritten text at the bottom labels the scene, and the reverse side shows typical divided-back postcard layout with printed Hungarian text.
